_readme: Drop a new option folder (with spec.json + model) inside its category folder, then add the folder name to that category's options list below. Nothing in index.html / main.css / main.js needs to change.

instructor.text: Welcome to the Navigation & Positioning Lab. We will build up a drone's GPS constellation geometry, measure its horizontal accuracy, profile a barometric altimeter against the ISA atmosphere, then combine both into a full 3-D error budget.

Module 1 — Constellation Geometry & Accuracy. Open the Constellation card and drag satellites on the sky-plot editor (elevation 90° at the centre, the horizon at the rim). HDOP / VDOP / PDOP update live as you spread, cluster, or line them up — and HDOP alone isn't a distance, so the run also multiplies it by the receiver's ranging error (UERE) to give CEP, the radius that contains half of all fixes. Try the urban-canyon multipath scenario and watch the fix cloud balloon outward.

Module 2 — ISA Altitude Profiling. The barometer infers altitude purely from pressure using the ISA lapse-rate model. Slide the altitude control and compare the sensed vs. true altitude column — a coarse sensor scatters, a temperature inversion biases the whole reading.

Module 3 — Error Budget Synthesis. GPS gives you a horizontal CEP, the barometer gives you a vertical error — combine them as a 3-D ellipsoid: total = √(CEP² + h_err²). Keep the total under 5 m and the drone is safe to fly autonomously near the obstacle.
Outstanding — every experiment is complete. Your GPS module reward is now unlocked in the Outputs panel.
